name: How long does painting and finishing an addition typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does painting and finishing an addition typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for painting and finishing an addition depends on its size, complexity, and the specific finishes chosen. Smaller additions might take a few days, while larger or more intricate projects could extend to a week or more. Factors like drying times between coats, weather conditions (for exterior work), and the number of painters involved also influence the timeline. We can provide a more accurate estimate after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The time to paint and finish an addition varies by size, complexity, and chosen finishes, from a few days to over a week.
